description: This source file defines the ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface to provide a list of gateway URIs for Orleans clusters using ZooKeeper as the backend membership provider. It includes methods for initialization, retrieving gateways, and configuration details, utilizing other Orleans and ZooKeeper components.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to supply gateway addresses for Orleans clusters via ZooKeeper.

methods.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initialization method, currently a no-op, for setting up the provider.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of active gateway URIs from ZooKeeper.

methods.name: MaxStaleness
methods.description: Property specifying how stale the gateway list can be.

methods.name: IsUpdatable
methods.description: Property indicating whether the gateway list can be dynamically refreshed.
